title: Barrels Expanded
description: Turns chests into barrels using either FastChest or Custom Entity Models.
body:
### Barrels Expanded
### 
This Resource Pack turns all of the different vanilla chest variants into barrels.
The pack has single, double, trapped, and even Ender barrels.
It supports both Custom Entity Models and Block models with mods like FastChest.
Can you ever have enough barrels?
